![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The "Tests" column for `ImageGenerationSeam` now points to `tests/contract/image-generation.test.ts`. However, this file was previously associated with the legacy seam implementation, and its dependencies (the old adapter and mock) have been deleted in this PR. It is likely that this test file is now broken or that you intended to point to the test file from the self-contained layout (`src/lib/seams/image-generation-seam/test.ts`), which was previously listed in the deleted row.
